# --force is the break-glass forward deploy: it skips the review, environment-
# dependency and staleness gates and NOTHING else. It grants no authority that
# didn't already exist — `rollback deploy` has always skipped the same three for
# anyone holding the deploy role — but it names the decision honestly and records
# it as "forced" instead of filing a forward deploy in the history as a rollback.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token
exec breeze register identity ci
cp stdout ci.token
exec breeze assign role deployer ci --as admin --token-file admin.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token

# A normal deploy is correctly gated on the review that hasn't happened.
! exec breeze start stage svc deploy abc123 --env prod --as ci --token-file ci.token
stderr 'prerequisite "review"'

# --force without a written reason is refused: the record is the whole point.
! exec breeze start stage svc deploy abc123 --env prod --force --as ci --token-file ci.token
stderr 'requires a written reason'

# With one, it goes out.
exec breeze start stage svc deploy abc123 --env prod --force --brief 'sev1: prod is down, review board asleep' --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'deploy: succeeded'

# Recorded as forced — distinguishable from both a normal deploy and a rollback.
exec breeze list deploys svc deploy --env prod --json
stdout '"outcome":\s*"forced"'

# It is not a way around authorization.
exec breeze register identity nobody
cp stdout nobody.token
! exec breeze start stage svc deploy def456 --env prod --force --brief 'trying it on' --as nobody --token-file nobody.token
stderr 'lacks required role'

# ...nor a flag you can wave at a stage that has no ordering gates to skip: a
# silent no-op there would leave the caller believing a gate was bypassed.
! exec breeze start stage svc build abc123 --force --brief 'why' --as ci --token-file ci.token
stderr 'applies to deploy stages only'

exec breeze stop

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "svc" {
  environments = ["prod"]

  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "review" {
    type               = "approval"
    required_approvals = 1
    approver_role      = "reviewer"
  }
  stage "deploy" {
    type          = "deploy"
    fans_out      = true
    required_role = "deployer"
    timeout       = "10s"
    command       = ["/bin/true", "{commit}", "{environment}"]
  }
}
